title: La Gloria de Linares, MAJESTIC STORIES
comment: gloria-linares (MAJESTIC): casa y fábrica de glorias en Linares, Nuevo León. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.ABUNDIO_TREVINO: Mexican man from Nuevo León, candy maker, 72 years old, thin, light skin, white hair combed back, a neat white mustache, a blue-and-white checkered western shirt with pearl snaps, grey trousers, a brown leather belt, brown boots, his hands empty.
chars.MAURICIO_TREVINO: Mexican man from Nuevo León, 40 years old, slightly overweight, light skin, short dark hair, clean-shaven round face, a navy-blue polo shirt, khaki trousers, brown loafers, his hands empty.
chars.FABIOLA_GARZA: Mexican woman, 38 years old, light skin, long straight bleached-blonde hair, heavy makeup, a white sleeveless dress, large sunglasses pushed up on her head, many gold bracelets, white heels, holding a glass of orange juice.
chars.CONSUELO_VILLARREAL: Mexican businesswoman, 62 years old, elegant, light skin, a short silver bob haircut, pearl earrings, a cream-colored pantsuit, a small brown leather handbag, holding dark sunglasses.

locs.LOC_CASALINARES: Front of a large two-story family house in Linares, Nuevo León, in the hot afternoon: wide stone steps up to a covered front porch, a big wooden door, orange trees in the yard, a small brick candy workshop beside the house with copper pots, an iron gate to a quiet street, bright sun, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
